error_states: EXPIRY_JOB_FAILED: Batch expiry evaluation could not complete; re-queued for next cycle

Internal alert dispatched to the fraud team with full transaction context
error_states: VELOCITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Earning event rate exceeds fraud threshold; transaction blocked pending review
REDEMPTION_PATTERN_FLAGGED: Redemption volume triggers anomaly alert

preconditions: Authenticated merchant admin with LOYALTY_ADMIN role

preconditions: Authenticated merchant admin or manager with dashboard access permission

preconditions: Consumer has an active wallet account with at least 30 days of transaction history

preconditions: Consumer app has previously completed a successful online session and seeded the local cache

OFFLINE_ACTION_EXPIRED: A queued action's validity window elapsed before sync; action discarded and consumer notified

preconditions: User (merchant prospect) has uploaded a processing statement in a supported format (PDF, CSV, image)

UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT: Uploaded file type is not in the supported list
PAN_DETECTED_AND_BLOCKED: File contains raw card numbers; upload rejected with privacy notice

preconditions: A valid processing profile (from OCR or manual entry) with at minimum: monthly volume, effective rate, and primary card mix

MODEL_VERSION_MISMATCH: Pricing model version used for calculation does not match the current published version

preconditions: Savings calculation has been successfully computed
User has not yet provided contact information (ungated state)
data_invariants: Full savings result is withheld until the lead capture form is completed

preconditions: Partner/reseller must have an active affiliate or reseller account with a registered domain whitelist

WIDGET_LOAD_TIMEOUT: Embed script fails to render within 3 seconds; fallback static link displayed

preconditions: Analytics event tracking must be instrumented on every funnel step (upload, calculate, gate, submit)
User has not opted out of analytics tracking
data_invariants: Funnel drop-off is calculated per session, not per user, to accommodate anonymous users
Conversion rate is defined as (submitted leads) / (total sessions reaching calculation step)

error_states: ANALYTICS_PIPELINE_LAG: Reporting data is more than 2 hours stale; banner displayed on dashboard
EXPORT_SIZE_EXCEEDED: Report export exceeds maximum row limit; user prompted to reduce date range
TRACKING_DISABLED: Session opted out of analytics; funnel data for this session not recorded

preconditions: Infrastructure deployed across a minimum of 2 geographically separated availability zones
Health checks and load balancer routing rules are configured and active
data_invariants: SLA target: 99.99% monthly uptime for payment-critical paths (< 4.38 minutes downtime/month)
SLA target: 99.9% monthly uptime for non-critical paths (analytics, reporting)
No single point of failure permitted in the payment processing or ledger write paths
Database read replicas must be in a separate AZ from the primary write node
postconditions: Failover to secondary AZ completes within the defined RTO (default: < 30 seconds for payment paths)
Availability metrics tracked per service and per endpoint in the observability stack
SLA breach automatically triggers a P1 incident and on-call page
error_states: AZ_FAILURE: Primary availability zone is unreachable; automatic failover to secondary initiated
HEALTH_CHECK_FAILURE: Service repeatedly fails health probe; removed from load balancer rotation
SLA_BREACH_DETECTED: Calculated uptime for the rolling 30-day window falls below the SLA target

preconditions: Services are deployed with appropriate resource allocations (CPU, memory) for projected load
Performance benchmarks are defined per endpoint category
data_invariants: Payment authorization API P99 latency must be < 500ms under 10x normal peak load
POS order creation API P99 latency must be < 300ms under normal load
Dashboard page load (LCP) must be < 2.5 seconds on a standard broadband connection
Database query plans for all hot-path queries must not include sequential table scans on tables > 10k rows
postconditions: Performance baselines published and tracked per release
Load test results attached to every release candidate that touches a hot-path API
Automated performance regression alert triggered if P99 degrades > 20% from baseline
error_states: LATENCY_SLA_BREACH: P99 latency exceeds defined threshold under normal load conditions
LOAD_TEST_FAILURE: Release candidate does not meet performance gate; deployment blocked
SEQUENTIAL_SCAN_DETECTED: Query plan analysis identifies a sequential scan on a production table

preconditions: Automated backup jobs must be configured for all stateful data stores (databases, object storage)
A documented and tested DR runbook must exist
data_invariants: RPO (Recovery Point Objective): < 1 hour for all financial ledger data
RTO (Recovery Time Objective): < 4 hours for full platform restoration from backup
Backups are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and stored in a geographically separate region
Backup integrity is verified via automated restore-and-checksum tests on a weekly schedule
postconditions: Successful backup creation confirmed and logged with size, duration, and checksum
DR drill results documented and linked to the runbook after each test
Backup retention follows the defined policy (daily for 30 days, weekly for 1 year, monthly for 7 years)
error_states: BACKUP_JOB_FAILED: Scheduled backup did not complete; on-call alert triggered
RESTORE_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: Backup integrity test fails; backup flagged as corrupted
RPO_BREACH: Data loss window from a failure event exceeds the 1-hour RPO target

preconditions: All services must instrument structured logs, metrics, and distributed traces

data_invariants: Every inbound API request must be assigned a globally unique Trace ID propagated through all downstream calls

postconditions: End-to-end request trace visible in the distributed tracing UI

Alert fires within 60 seconds of an SLO breach event
error_states: TRACE_ID_MISSING: Request received without a propagated trace ID; new ID generated and warning logged
METRICS_PIPELINE_DOWN: Metric ingestion has stopped; alert fires within 5 minutes of gap detection
LOG_RETENTION_POLICY_BREACH: Logs older than the hot retention window were not archived before deletion

requirements.description: Multi-Channel Notification Dispatch with Channel Fallback

NOTIFICATION_STORM_THROTTLED: Outbound notification rate exceeds the platform throttle; messages queued

preconditions: A chargeback notification has been received from the acquiring bank

preconditions: All transactions for the settlement period must be in a CAPTURED state

preconditions: Order has an outstanding balance > 0

requirements.description: Wallet as Payment Method at POS

POS terminal is configured to accept PaySurity wallet payments
Consumer's wallet balance is sufficient to cover the transaction amount
data_invariants: Wallet payment at POS follows the same double-entry ledger invariant as all wallet transactions
Transaction amount is pre-authorized against the wallet balance before the POS order is finalized
Loyalty points earning (if applicable) is triggered by the wallet payment event
postconditions: Consumer's wallet balance decremented by the transaction amount
Merchant's settlement account credited as part of the daily settlement batch
Transaction appears in both the consumer's wallet history and the merchant's POS transaction log
error_states: WALLET_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT: Consumer's available balance is below the transaction amount
POS_WALLET_NOT_CONFIGURED: The POS terminal is not authorized to accept wallet payments
WALLET_FROZEN: Consumer's wallet is under a compliance hold and cannot be used for payments

preconditions: Requesting user has an active, verified wallet account
Target recipient is identified by phone, email, or wallet ID
Request amount is positive and within the configured P2P request limit
data_invariants: A payment request does not move funds; it creates a pending request record only
Request expires after a configurable period (default: 7 days) if not fulfilled
Recipient can fulfill the request partially or in full; partial fulfillment creates a new residual request
postconditions: Payment request record created and linked to both sender and recipient accounts
Recipient notified via push/SMS with request details and a one-tap fulfillment action
Upon fulfillment, a P2P transfer is initiated per REQ-WAL-004
error_states: REQUEST_EXPIRED: Recipient did not fulfill the request within the validity window
SELF_REQUEST_PROHIBITED: User attempted to send a payment request to themselves
RECIPIENT_BLOCKED_SENDER: Target has blocked payment requests from the sender

preconditions: Merchant or payee has generated a QR code or deep link payment request via the wallet platform
Consumer is authenticated and has the consumer wallet app or a deep-link capable browser
data_invariants: QR payment flow reuses the canonical REQ-WAL-005 payment request protocol
Deep links must be validated against the platform's registered URL scheme before processing
Wallet context (balance, identity) is resolved from the authenticated session, not from the QR payload
postconditions: Payment processed per REQ-WAL-005 postconditions
Merchant POS or payee dashboard reflects the payment in real time via webhook
Consumer wallet transaction history updated immediately
error_states: DEEP_LINK_SCHEME_INVALID: URL scheme does not match the registered PaySurity wallet protocol
QR_EXPIRED: Payment QR has passed expiry per REQ-WAL-005 rules
WALLET_SESSION_NOT_FOUND: Consumer deep link opened without an active wallet session; redirect to login

preconditions: Parent wallet account is active and in good standing
Feature availability is gated by the consumer's wallet tier or plan
data_invariants: Sub-account behavior follows REQ-WAL-006 invariants exactly
Wallet tier restrictions on the number of sub-accounts are enforced at creation time
Auto-save rule changes are not retroactive; they apply only to transactions after the change timestamp
postconditions: Sub-account created and visible in the consumer wallet app under a dedicated 'Goals' or 'Savings' section
Auto-save rules configured and active for subsequent qualifying transactions
Sub-account balance excluded from the main wallet's available spending balance display
error_states: TIER_RESTRICTION: Consumer's wallet plan does not include sub-account creation
DUPLICATE_GOAL_LABEL: Consumer attempted to create two sub-accounts with the same label
AUTO_SAVE_CONFLICT: Two rules targeting the same trigger event create an ambiguous execution order

preconditions: Consumer has configured at least one automated money movement rule in their wallet settings
Rule target (sub-account, external bank, bill payee) is verified and active
data_invariants: Automated rule execution follows REQ-WAL-007 invariants exactly
Rules are evaluated in a defined priority order if multiple rules share a trigger
Consumers can pause, resume, or delete rules at any time; changes take effect immediately
postconditions: Automated movement executes and appears in the transaction history as AUTOMATED type
Consumer receives a push notification for each automated movement execution
Rule execution log maintains a full history of all executions for the consumer to review
error_states: RULE_PRIORITY_CONFLICT: Multiple rules with equal priority and the same trigger cannot be deterministically ordered
EXTERNAL_BANK_LINK_EXPIRED: ACH link to external bank has been revoked; automated movement fails
RULE_PAUSED_BY_SYSTEM: System automatically paused a rule after 3 consecutive failures; consumer notified

preconditions: Parent account holder has completed the guardian consent flow for the dependent
Dependent is under the minimum age threshold for an independent account (configurable, default: 18)
data_invariants: Dependent account behavior follows REQ-WAL-008 invariants exactly
Parent can modify spending limits and category restrictions at any time; changes are effective immediately
Dependent account is automatically converted to an independent account upon reaching the age threshold, subject to re-verification
postconditions: Dependent account fully configured with all parent-defined restrictions applied
Parent dashboard shows a consolidated view of all dependent accounts and their activity
Age threshold event (birthday) triggers a notification to the parent for account transition review
error_states: DEPENDENT_AGE_INVALID: Age verification check fails for the dependent's provided date of birth
ACCOUNT_TRANSITION_FAILED: Age-threshold account conversion failed; account remains dependent pending manual review
RESTRICTION_UPDATE_CONFLICT: Parent and system-level restriction conflict; system restriction takes precedence

requirements.description: Tenant microsite auto-provisioning on tenant signup
preconditions: New tenant signup event has been emitted by the core onboarding service
Tenant record is in ACTIVE state with a confirmed business name and category
data_invariants: Each tenant is provisioned exactly one microsite; duplicate provisioning is prevented by an idempotency check on the tenant ID
Default microsite template is assigned based on the tenant's business category
Microsite subdomain is derived from the business name with conflict resolution (numeric suffix appended on collision)
postconditions: Microsite record created in the tenant configuration store with a unique subdomain
Default content (placeholder menu, business info from signup) populated from the tenant profile
Tenant notified via email with their microsite URL and admin access credentials
error_states: SUBDOMAIN_COLLISION_UNRESOLVABLE: All numeric suffixes up to the configured limit are taken; provisioning halted, manual intervention required
TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: Business category does not map to any defined template; default template applied with warning
TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE: Signup event fired for a tenant in PENDING or SUSPENDED state; provisioning deferred

preconditions: Tenant has an active microsite provisioned
Tenant has provided a custom domain they own and has added the required CNAME record at their DNS registrar
data_invariants: CNAME verification must confirm the domain resolves to the PaySurity microsite hosting endpoint before activation
SSL certificate must be automatically provisioned (e.g., via Let's Encrypt / ACME) for the custom domain
Only one custom domain can be active per microsite at a time; adding a new one deprovisions the previous
postconditions: Custom domain is verified, SSL is provisioned, and the microsite is accessible via the tenant's domain
PaySurity subdomain continues to resolve and redirects (301) to the custom domain
Custom domain and SSL expiry dates are tracked and auto-renewal is scheduled 30 days before expiry
error_states: CNAME_VERIFICATION_FAILED: DNS lookup does not resolve to the expected PaySurity endpoint after a configurable timeout
SSL_PROVISIONING_FAILED: ACME challenge failed; custom domain remains unverified
DOMAIN_ALREADY_CLAIMED: The provided custom domain is already mapped to another tenant's microsite

requirements.description: Menu management CRUD (categories, items, prices, images)
preconditions: Tenant admin is authenticated and authorized with MENU_ADMIN role for the microsite
Microsite is in an active, provisioned state
data_invariants: Each menu item must have at minimum: name, category, base price, and availability status
Images must be validated for format (JPEG/PNG/WebP), maximum size (5MB), and minimum resolution (800x800px) before storage
Price must be stored as an integer (minor units per ISO 4217) with the currency code specified
postconditions: Menu changes are reflected on the live microsite within 60 seconds of save (CDN cache invalidated)
If POS sync is active (MST-007), changes are propagated to the POS menu configuration
Version history of menu changes maintained for audit and rollback purposes
error_states: IMAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED: Uploaded image fails format, size, or resolution check
PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM: Configured price is below the platform minimum (e.g., $0.50)
POS_SYNC_CONFLICT: Menu change conflicts with a concurrent POS-side change; conflict surfaced for manual resolution

requirements.description: Price calculation engine: displayPrice = base x (1 + processingFee) x (1 + marginPct)
preconditions: Base price for the menu item must be defined
Processing fee rate and margin percentage must be configured (globally or per-tenant)
data_invariants: displayPrice = base_price_minor_units * (1 + processing_fee_rate) * (1 + margin_pct), rounded up to the nearest minor unit
All intermediate calculations must be performed in integer arithmetic with explicit rounding at the final step only
The formula components (base, processing_fee_rate, margin_pct) must be logged per calculation for audit purposes
postconditions: Display price surfaced on the microsite for the consumer
Price calculation audit record stored linking the display price to its formula inputs
If either rate changes, all affected display prices are recalculated synchronously before the change is published
error_states: NEGATIVE_DISPLAY_PRICE: Calculation results in a zero or negative display price; item hidden pending admin review
RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Processing fee or margin rate is undefined; calculation cannot proceed
OVERFLOW_DETECTED: Integer arithmetic overflow detected during calculation; error logged and item price flagged

requirements.description: PaySurity margin configurable by super admin (default 20%)
preconditions: Actor holds the SUPER_ADMIN role
Target scope (global default or specific tenant override) is specified
data_invariants: Margin percentage must be between 0% and 100% (exclusive bounds)
A change to the global default does not retroactively affect tenants with explicit overrides
All margin configuration changes are versioned with the actor ID, timestamp, and previous value
postconditions: New margin rate applied to the target scope immediately
All affected microsite display prices recalculated and republished within 5 minutes
Change audit record created in the platform admin audit log
error_states: MARGIN_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Configured rate is <= 0% or >= 100%
UNAUTHORIZED_ACTOR: Non-super-admin attempting to modify global or tenant margin
PRICE_RECALCULATION_FAILED: Recalculation job failed for one or more items; failed items flagged for retry

preconditions: Actor holds the SUPER_ADMIN or FINANCE_ADMIN role
Target scope (global default or per-tenant override) is specified
data_invariants: Processing fee percentage must be between 0% and 10% (hard ceiling enforced by the system)
Per-tenant overrides are evaluated in the price calculation before the global default
All processing fee configuration changes are versioned per MST-005 audit standards
postconditions: New processing fee applied to the specified scope immediately
Display prices for all affected microsite items recalculated
Merchants with per-tenant overrides are notified of any global rate changes that would affect them if overrides were removed
error_states: FEE_EXCEEDS_CEILING: Configured rate exceeds the 10% hard ceiling
TENANT_OVERRIDE_CONFLICT: A global change attempts to set a rate lower than an active tenant override without explicit resolution
NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_FAILED: Merchant fee change notification could not be delivered

requirements.description: POS <-> Microsite bidirectional sync (menu changes reflect on both)
preconditions: The tenant has an active POS system integration configured
POS sync is explicitly enabled by the tenant admin
data_invariants: Sync is event-driven: a change event in either system triggers a sync to the other within a configurable window (default: 60s)
Conflict resolution policy: the most recent timestamp wins unless a manual lock is applied
Price sync propagates base prices only; the display price formula is applied by the microsite engine (not the POS)
postconditions: Menu item CRUD operations are reflected in both systems within the sync window
Sync log records every event with direction (POS-to-SITE or SITE-to-POS), item ID, and resolution outcome
Merchant can view pending sync items and manually trigger a force-sync from the admin panel
error_states: SYNC_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVABLE: Both systems modified the same item within the same timestamp window; manual intervention required
POS_INTEGRATION_OFFLINE: POS system is unreachable; changes queued locally until connectivity restored
SYNC_LOOP_DETECTED: Mutual trigger loop detected between POS and microsite; sync paused and alert raised

requirements.description: Catering orders with advance notice enforcement (minimum 48h)
preconditions: Tenant has catering order capability enabled in their microsite configuration
Customer has selected a catering item or package from the microsite menu
data_invariants: Catering order submission timestamp plus minimum advance notice (configurable, default: 48 hours) must be <= the requested fulfillment datetime
Catering orders require a non-refundable deposit (configurable percentage, default: 25%) at time of order
Catering order minimum spend threshold (if configured) must be met before checkout is permitted
postconditions: Catering order placed with a PENDING_CONFIRMATION status pending merchant review
Deposit charged to the customer's payment method immediately
Merchant notified of the new catering order with full details for confirmation or counter-offer
error_states: ADVANCE_NOTICE_VIOLATED: Requested fulfillment time is less than the minimum advance notice window
MINIMUM_SPEND_NOT_MET: Cart total for the catering order is below the configured minimum
DEPOSIT_PAYMENT_FAILED: Deposit authorization declined; order not placed

requirements.description: Special event orders (large party) with advance notice and prepayment
preconditions: Tenant has special event ordering capability enabled
Party size meets or exceeds the threshold defined as a 'special event' (configurable, default: 50 guests)
data_invariants: Special event orders require full prepayment (100%) at time of booking
Cancellation policy for special events must be explicitly presented and acknowledged by the customer before checkout
Special event date must be at least the configured minimum lead time in the future (default: 7 days)
postconditions: Special event order placed with PREPAID status
Full payment captured immediately upon order submission
Event details synced to the merchant's calendar integration (if configured)
error_states: PARTY_SIZE_BELOW_THRESHOLD: Order does not meet the minimum guest count for special event classification
LEAD_TIME_INSUFFICIENT: Booking date is within the minimum lead time window
CANCELLATION_POLICY_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: Customer did not confirm acknowledgment of the cancellation terms

requirements.description: Tenant Admin Panel for CRUD operations
preconditions: Tenant admin is authenticated with TENANT_ADMIN or higher role
Microsite is in active state
data_invariants: All admin panel actions are logged in the tenant audit trail with actor, timestamp, and changed values
Destructive actions (delete item, disable microsite) require a confirmation prompt and are irreversible after confirmation
Admin panel UI enforces the same business rule validations as the API layer
postconditions: CRUD operations execute successfully and are reflected in the live microsite
Tenant admin receives a summary email of all changes made in a session (configurable: immediate or daily digest)
Session activity logged for security audit
error_states: PERMISSION_INSUFFICIENT: Actor attempts an action requiring a higher privilege level
OPTIMISTIC_LOCK_CONFLICT: Another admin modified the same record concurrently; actor prompted to refresh and retry
AUDIT_LOG_WRITE_FAILURE: Admin action succeeded but audit log write failed; critical alert raised

requirements.description: Super admin override of per-tenant settings
preconditions: Actor holds the SUPER_ADMIN role
Target tenant ID is valid and the tenant is in an active state
data_invariants: Super admin overrides supersede all tenant-configured settings for the targeted field
All super admin overrides are tagged with a mandatory reason code and stored in a separate override audit log
Tenants are notified of super admin overrides affecting their configuration within 24 hours unless explicitly suppressed for compliance reasons
postconditions: Tenant configuration updated to reflect the super admin override
Override audit record created with: actor, tenant ID, field, old value, new value, reason code, timestamp
If applicable, display prices or other derived values recalculated and published
error_states: TENANT_NOT_FOUND: Provided tenant ID does not exist
REASON_CODE_MISSING: Override attempted without a mandatory reason code
OVERRIDE_CREATES_INVALID_STATE: The override would result in a logically invalid configuration; blocked with error detail

requirements.description: SEO: per-tenant meta tags, structured data (Restaurant schema.org)
preconditions: Microsite is provisioned and publicly accessible
Tenant business information (name, address, phone, cuisine) is populated in the tenant profile
data_invariants: Each page must have a unique meta title and meta description; duplicate meta across pages is prohibited
schema.org Restaurant structured data must include: name, address, telephone, openingHours, and servesCuisine
Structured data must be validated against the schema.org specification before publication
postconditions: Meta tags and structured data rendered in the page <head> for all indexed pages
Structured data passes Google Rich Results Test validation
SEO configuration changes are reflected within the CDN cache invalidation window (< 60s)
error_states: STRUCTURED_DATA_VALIDATION_FAILED: Generated JSON-LD fails schema.org validation; page published without structured data, warning logged
DUPLICATE_META_DETECTED: Two pages have identical meta titles; publishing blocked until resolved
REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING: A mandatory structured data field is absent from the tenant profile; default placeholder applied with warning

preconditions: Microsite template is deployed and publicly accessible
Core Web Vitals measurement tooling is configured for the microsite
data_invariants: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) must be < 2.5 seconds on a simulated mid-range mobile device
CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) must be < 0.1 on all primary pages
INP (Interaction to Next Paint) must be < 200 milliseconds
All images must have explicit width and height attributes to prevent layout shift
postconditions: Microsite passes Core Web Vitals assessment on both mobile and desktop
Responsive layout renders correctly at breakpoints: 375px, 768px, 1280px, 1920px
Automated CWV regression test runs on each template deployment
error_states: LCP_REGRESSION: A deployment causes LCP to exceed the 2.5s threshold; deployment flagged
CLS_VIOLATION: Layout shift score exceeds 0.1; root cause identified as a missing image dimension attribute
RESPONSIVE_BREAKPOINT_FAILURE: A critical UI element overflows its container at a defined breakpoint

requirements.description: Order flow: menu -> cart -> checkout -> confirmation
preconditions: Microsite is active and accepting online orders
Menu has at least one available item
Payment processing is enabled for the tenant
data_invariants: Cart state is maintained in the browser session; server-side cart is created only at checkout initiation
Item availability is re-validated at checkout initiation against the live inventory state
Order total displayed at checkout must match the server-calculated total to prevent price manipulation
postconditions: Order successfully placed, payment captured, and confirmation screen displayed with order ID and ETA
Order event dispatched to the merchant's POS or order management system
Confirmation email and/or SMS sent to the customer with order summary
error_states: ITEM_UNAVAILABLE_AT_CHECKOUT: An item became unavailable between cart add and checkout; customer prompted to remove
PRICE_MISMATCH: Client-calculated total does not match server total; checkout blocked, cart refreshed
PAYMENT_DECLINED: Payment method declined at checkout; customer prompted to use an alternate method

requirements.description: Real-time order sync with POS when activated
preconditions: POS integration is active and the sync feature is enabled (per MST-007)
A new order has been successfully placed on the microsite
data_invariants: Order sync is a one-way push from microsite to POS for new orders (POS is authoritative for order status updates)
Order payload must include: items, modifiers, customer note, requested fulfillment time, and payment confirmation
Sync must complete within the defined latency SLA (default: 10 seconds from order confirmation)
postconditions: Order appears in the POS order queue and/or KDS within the sync SLA window
POS order ID is returned and stored as a reference on the microsite order record
Sync failure triggers an automatic SMS/push alert to the merchant with the order details as a fallback
error_states: POS_SYNC_TIMEOUT: POS system did not acknowledge the order within the SLA; fallback notification sent
ORDER_PAYLOAD_REJECTED: POS returned a validation error on the order payload; error details logged for triage
POS_OFFLINE: POS system is unreachable; order queued for sync upon POS reconnection, merchant alerted immediately

preconditions: Tenant account is active with a defined billing subscription
Tenant has been assigned to a specific CFO billing tier
data_invariants: Tier definitions (features, limits, price) are versioned; a tier change is non-retroactive (applies from the next billing cycle)
Feature access is enforced at the API layer based on the tenant's current tier; no client-side gating only
Tier limits (e.g., max menu items, max locations) are hard limits; exceeding them is blocked, not silently truncated
postconditions: Tenant's feature access reflects their current tier assignment
Tier assignment change triggers a re-evaluation of all active features and a welcome/change email
Invoice for the next billing cycle reflects the updated tier pricing
error_states: TIER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Tenant attempts to add a feature or resource beyond their tier's hard limit
TIER_NOT_FOUND: An undefined tier code is assigned to a tenant; tenant defaults to Foundation tier with alert
BILLING_TIER_MISMATCH: Tenant's active features do not match their assigned tier after a plan change; reconciliation job triggered

requirements.description: Elite Tier Segment (Vibrant Spice / Minimalist Artisanal Templates)
preconditions: Tenant must be on the Elite billing tier (MST-016)
Tenant has selected an Elite template from the template library
data_invariants: Elite templates are strictly gated behind the Elite tier; access by lower-tier tenants is blocked at the API and UI layers
Template customization options are bounded by the defined customization schema per template (no arbitrary CSS injection)
All Elite template assets (fonts, images) must be served from PaySurity's CDN, not externally linked
postconditions: Elite template applied to the tenant's microsite with their branding (logo, colors) injected per the customization schema
Template change is live within the CDN propagation window (< 60 seconds)
Previous template version archived for a configurable rollback window (default: 30 days)
error_states: TIER_ACCESS_DENIED: Non-Elite tenant attempts to apply an Elite template; request blocked
CUSTOMIZATION_SCHEMA_VIOLATION: Submitted customization payload contains fields not defined in the template schema
ASSET_LOAD_FAILURE: A required Elite template asset is unavailable from the CDN; template deployment blocked
